description: The roster as published by the promotion on its own athlete profiles (UFC today): every fighter it lists as active (or, with status, off_roster or retired), each with the division, the date the status was first observed (null when it predates our first check), the date it was last confirmed, the last bout and the next booking. off_roster means the promotion no longer lists the fighter on its roster; it does not say why. Narrow with division. Cursor paginated. Pro plans and up.

org.description: A promotion that publishes its roster ("ufc").

status.description: active (default), off_roster (no longer listed on the roster) or retired.

name: get_roster
title: Get a promotion's current roster
